name: levobunolol
uses: INDICATIONS AND USAGE Levobunolol hydrochloride ophthalmic solution has been shown to be effective in lowering intraocular pressure and may be used in patients with chronic open-angle glaucoma or ocular hypertension.
pediatric: Pediatric Use Safety and effectiveness in pediatric patients have not been established.
contra: CONTRAINDICATIONS Levobunolol hydrochloride ophthalmic solution is contraindicated in those individuals with bronchial asthma, or with a history of bronchial asthma, or severe chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (see WARNINGS ); sinus bradycardia; second and third degree atrioventricular block; overt cardiac failure (see WARNINGS ); cardiogenic shock; or hypersensitivity to any component of these products.
